title: One Window, Long Queue
statement:
A service window serves customers one at a time in the order they arrive. Customer `i` arrives at time `a_i` and needs `s_i` units of service. The window starts serving a customer as soon as it is free and that customer has arrived. A customer's waiting time is the gap between arriving and being served. Compute the total waiting time of all customers.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. Each of the next `n` lines contains `a_i` and `s_i`. Customers are listed in the order they arrive, so `a_1 <= a_2 <= ... <= a_n`.

## Output
Print the sum of the waiting times of all customers. The answer can be larger than 32 bits.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 20000`
- `0 <= a_i <= 10^9`
- `1 <= s_i <= 10^6`
